summary: Iterates a linked list rooted at a2+36 (node next pointer at i[48]); for each node with i[41] > 0 entries, walks its entry array (first entry at i[42]+140, stride 148). When an entry's byte at offset -76 has bit 1 set, dereferences a target at *(entry_ptr + 84), and if target+20 is zero, clears bit 0 of target+24, sets bit 3 of target+24, calls sub_53F720(this, target, 0), then sets bit 0 of target+24. Returns the last node's entry count.

operations.description: Initialize result to a2 before the traversal.
Traverse the linked list whose head is at a2+36; each node's next pointer is i[48], loop continues while the node is non-null.
Set result to i[42], the entry-array base pointer of the current node.
Only iterate entries when the signed count i[41] is greater than 0.
do-while over i[41] entries starting at result+140 with entry stride 148.
Check the byte at entry offset -76 for bit 1 (value 2) being set.
Dereference the entry pointer: v7 = *( *(DWORD *)v6 + 84 ) where v6 points at the current entry.
Only act when the DWORD at v7+20 is zero (state not already active).
Clear bit 0 of the DWORD at v7+24.
Set bit 3 (value 8) of the DWORD at target+24 where target is *( *(DWORD *)v6 + 84 ).
Call sub_53F720(this, target, 0) with target as the dereferenced entry object.
Set bit 0 of the DWORD at target+24 after the call.
Return result, which holds the last node's entry count i[41] (or a2 when no node iterated).

unresolved: Semantics of sub_53F720 (callee) and the meaning of its third argument 0 are outside this packet.
The identity of the node/list and entry types, and the meaning of the target+24 flag bits, are unknown.
Why the flag at entry offset -76 gates the per-entry state transition is unexplained.
